d:
Nepal ke pradhanmantri balendr shah ke bharat daure se donon deshon ke rishton men sudhar ki naee ummid jagi hai. bharat ne nepal ke punarnirman aur vikas ke lie 15,000 karor rupye ke sahyog paikej ki ghoshna ki hai. halanki, sima vivad aur 1950 ki maitri sandhi jaise lanbit muddon par nepal ki shikayton ko dur karna bhi jaruri hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
